flags: INCLUSION/FIT: The area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' and 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack (no Deer/Turkey)'. Rule 140 is standard, with no special-use-permit-only rule and no Rule 101. The brochure (12/2021) says 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots... No amenities are provided.' The map (03/17) draws a 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol beside every one of its 9 lots, and the 9 GIS camping points sit 10-60 m from the 9 GIS lots. This is lot-adjacent camping with designated points, so it stays under the 2026-11-09 rule. At the stored pin, imagery shows a gravel pull-off lot about 30 x 20 m on the gravel road, which takes a 23-ft rig.

PIN: the stored 40.33600,-92.27978 is GIS point 525, 11 m from lot 2273. Keep it. Alternative: the Ivy Road lot (GIS 528, 40.32350,-92.30231) and the Highway 15 lot (GIS 522, 40.32308,-92.21753) are the two lots with a privy.
CLUSTERS: 9 single lot-side points spread over about 8 km, each on its own lot and road. All are the same kind of spot; no split proposed. near.py finds no other entry nearby.
HORSES: horses are allowed on public roadways only. There is no horse camp.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the area has no boat ramps, and the pin lot sits by a small pond rather than the river.
PHONE: (573) 248-2530 on the area page and the brochure matches.

Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. Drive-in camping has no seasonal limit; only walk-in/backpack camping is closed during the firearms deer and turkey seasons. The 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row and isn't written per entry.
